02 · Detailing

Car detailing

A valet removes dirt. Detailing works on the paint itself: machine polishing to reduce swirls and light scratches, and coatings to protect the finish once it's right.

Ask about detailing Send photos of your paint

Valeting or detailing?

A valet

  • Cleans the car inside and out
  • Removes dirt, grime and everyday marks
  • Takes 2 to 6 hours, depending on the package
  • From £40, at published prices
Valet prices

Detailing

  • Machine polishes the paint to reduce swirls, haze and light scratches
  • Protects the finish with a coating that lasts far longer than a wax
  • [CONFIRM WITH REBEL: typical time, e.g. a full day or more]
  • [CONFIRM WITH REBEL: from-prices, or 'priced by quote after seeing the paint']

Signs your car would benefit from detailing

  • Fine circular scratches (swirl marks) show up in sunlight or under street lights
  • The paint looks flat or hazy even straight after a wash
  • Light scratches catch the light but don't catch your fingernail
  • You've just bought a car and want to protect the paint from the start

If your fingernail catches in a scratch, it has probably gone through the clear coat. Polishing can soften how it looks but won't remove it.

Detailing services

  • Machine polishing & paint correctionLevels the clear coat to reduce swirls, haze and light scratches.
  • Ceramic coatingA hard, water-repelling layer applied to prepared paint.

Looking for a deep interior clean? The Platinum Valet covers leather, the roof lining and full shampooing.

Detailing at your home

Getting a detailing quote

Send a few photos of the paint in daylight, plus a close-up of the worst area. A phone torch held at an angle shows swirls clearly. We'll tell you what polishing is likely to achieve before you book.
